主题游戏乐园
我来玩服饰
主题说说
这个故事，不仅能帮助孩子认识各种服饰，还能引导孩子学会如何穿衣服，
以及了解穿衣服的顺序。用这种贴近生活的方式去影响孩子，孩子必然是乐于
接受的。在生活中、游戏中、阅读中认知，认知随处可在。
宝贝这样玩
小朋友，请把右页上面的所有图片都剪下来。快看看，这些都是长颈鹿的
衣服哦！把这些衣服放到“宝贝作品展”的活动页面上，给上面的长颈鹿穿上
吧。想想先穿哪件，确定怎样穿之后，就用胶水粘上。下次，你穿衣服的时候，
也尝试自己来穿吧。
剪下后，将此部分粘到下页上，效果更好哦～

page_text_en:
Theme Game Park
I'll Play with Clothes
Theme Talk
This story can not only help children recognize various garments, but also guide them to learn how to dress, and understand the order of dressing. Using this approach close to real life to influence children, they will surely be happy to accept it. Cognitive learning can happen anywhere—in life, in games, and in reading.
How to Play, Kids
Children, please cut out all the pictures on the right page. Look, these are all the clothes for the giraffe! Place these clothes on the "Children's Art Exhibition" activity page and dress the giraffe up. Think about which piece to put on first, decide how to wear them, then glue them on. Next time you dress yourself, try doing it on your own too.
Cut out and stick this part onto the next page for better results~
